slides.title: How to set up a *90-minute deep work block.
Pick the *one task.
slides.body: Decide the night before. One task, written down, specific enough to start in 10 seconds.

slides.title: Book it like a *meeting.
slides.body: Put it in the calendar. If it's not booked, someone else will book it.

slides.title: Phone in *another room.
slides.body: Not face down. Not on silent. Out of reach.

slides.title: Close *everything else.
slides.body: One window, one tab. Email and chat stay shut until the block ends.

slides.title: Set a *timer.
slides.body: 90 minutes. When it rings, stop and take a real break.

slides.title: One block a day beats a *busy week.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
